title: SetAttributeSingle with short request-data boundary variation
purpose: Cover the settable-attribute decoder path using a small, explicitly present value whose size can be mutated without changing the outer framing.
expected_behavior: The server should decode the SetAttributeSingle request and either apply the four-byte value or return a deterministic CIP status for the selected attribute, while honoring the declared CPF and encapsulation lengths.
constraints_preserved: registered session handle is used for SendRRData
CPF data item length equals the complete CIP request
CIP service, path size, class, instance, and attribute fields are present
request data contains a bounded four-byte value
issue_safety_notes: The sequence models issue 569 through request-data sensitivity but avoids the historical oversized path and truncated decoder input. Mutations should adjust the value and declared lengths together.
